action.newText: AC-3 [unit] At completion of US-001, before US-009 gates invite cancellation, PENDING_GATE_ROUTES.get('DELETE /projects/:slug/invites/:id') returns 'gate-core-domains'. In US-009, replace this temporary assertion with PENDING_GATE_ROUTES.has('DELETE /projects/:slug/invites/:id') being false.

rationale: Preserves US-001's non-secret classification check and the mandated final rollout contract without changing production behavior or weakening contract validation.
